scripts.web:dev: cd core && npm run dev && cd ..
scripts.web:build: cd core && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.android:build: cd core && npm run build -- --mode android && cd .. && node copyBuildToAndroid.js
scripts.android:build-apk: npm run android:build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && apksigner sign --ks key.keystore --ks-key-alias micromonkey --out app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk && cd ..
scripts.electron:build: cd core && npm run build -- --mode electron && cd .. && node copyBuildToElectron.js
scripts.electron:build-packages: npm run electron:build && cd electron && npm run make && cd ..
scripts.website:build: npm run web:build && node copyBuildToDocs.js && npm run docs:build
scripts.website:deploy: npm run website:build && node copy-firebase-json.mjs prod && firebase deploy
scripts.website:deploy-beta: npm run website:build && node copy-firebase-json.mjs beta && firebase deploy
